body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one living creature within 4 units. On a success, it suffers -2 Movement until the end of its next turn.

surges.html: On a success, move one affected creature or unsecured object 1 unit.
Gain +1 Defense against the next Action that targets you before your next turn.

rider.title: FRACTURE — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, the target cannot Dash until the end of its next turn.
